title: Structural insight into dynamic switching mechanism of the SAM-IV riboswitch revealed by molecular simulations
task: Characterize SAM-IV riboswitch conformational dynamics and ligand-binding mechanism
key_results: SAM-bound state shows restricted ensemble with lower local fluctuations; apo state samples broader conformations; ligand removal redistributes tertiary contacts while maintaining some SAM-accommodation capacity
comments: 32 µs aggregate MD provides substantial sampling, but authors appropriately acknowledge that simulation-derived mechanistic hypothesis requires experimental kinetic validation and that scoring functions lack energetic resolution.

model_io.model: Molecular dynamics simulations (4 µs × 2 replicates per state)

hypotheses.hypothesis: SAM binding stabilizes a conformational subset while ligand removal permits broader sampling
hypotheses.result: Supported by ensemble analysis showing restricted SAM-bound ensemble vs. broader apo-state variability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Apo-derived conformations can accommodate SAM despite lower MM-GBSA scores
hypotheses.result: Ensemble docking revealed SAM-accommodating conformations in apo/ligand-removed states, though with unfavorable energetics relative to native bound state

title: Experimental limitations introduced during cluster analysis in super-resolution microscopy due to the choice of labeling methods and fluorophores
task: Quantify labeling-induced errors in super-resolution nanocluster size measurement
key_results: Antibody-based dSTORM shows ~42% quantification error relative to PALM; error decreases with smaller probes or monovalent nanobodies; linkage error is a major contributor to uncertainty
comments: Monte Carlo simulations paired with focal adhesion kinase benchmark provide systematic baseline, but FAK as single model system may not generalize across all protein-complex types.

model_io.model: Monte Carlo simulations of labeling geometry and stochastic blinking

hypotheses.hypothesis: Antibody-based labeling introduces larger quantification errors than smaller probes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: ~42% error for antibodies vs. lower error for nanobodies; error correlates with probe size and steric hindrance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Linkage error (distance from antibody to fluorophore) is a dominant source of nanocluster size quantification error
hypotheses.result: Supported by systematic decomposition of labeling-induced error contributions across SMLM methods

title: A novel of synthetic iridoid glycoside, Picroside II inhibits temozolomide resistance proliferation by upregulating DHRS2 in glioblastoma
task: Overcome temozolomide resistance in glioblastoma via DHRS2 upregulation
key_results: Picroside II (PII) inhibited TMZ-resistant GBM proliferation, induced G1-phase arrest and mitochondrial apoptosis; NGS revealed marked DHRS2 upregulation; PII suppressed xenograft tumor growth
comments: PII shows promise for reversing TMZ resistance through DHRS2 induction, though the mechanistic link between DHRS2 upregulation and apoptosis induction remains incompletely elucidated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PII induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in TMZ-resistant GBM cells
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; PII caused dose-dependent G1-phase accumulation and intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis with modulated apoptosis/cell cycle regulatory proteins

hypotheses.hypothesis: DHRS2 upregulation mediates PII's antitumor effects against TMZ resistance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by NGS and xenograft studies showing PII-induced DHRS2 upregulation correlating with tumor suppression

title: G3BP1-induced retrograde transport blockade triggers HSC activation and liver fibrosis via COPI alternative splicing
task: Identify molecular mechanisms driving hepatic stellate cell activation and liver fibrosis
key_results: G3BP1 upregulation promotes HSC activation through COPI alternative splicing; G3BP1 knockout attenuates fibrotic progression in CCl4/BDL models
comments: Novel identification of G3BP1-SRPK1-hnRNPM axis in regulating COPI splicing and ER stress represents an interesting therapeutic target, though the stress-granule-independent mechanism requires further mechanistic validation.

model_io.model: Human LX-2 HSCs and primary mouse HSCs

hypotheses.hypothesis: G3BP1 promotes COPI alternative splicing through hnRNPM interaction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via APEX-MS and transcriptomic analyses; G3BP1 recruits SRPK1 to phosphorylate hnRNPM

hypotheses.hypothesis: COPI isoform accumulation impairs retrograde transport and induces ER stress
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; exon 2-deficient COPG1 and exon 8-deficient COPB2 accumulation blocks retrograde transport and triggers HSC activation

title: Influenza A virus orchestrates ciliated cell fate and injury during the mucociliary damage repair cycle
task: Decipher host and viral mechanisms driving persistent mucociliary clearance dysfunction post-influenza
key_results: Longitudinal micro-OCT showed global MCC impairment persisting >14 days post-H1N1 PR8 infection; IFN-IDO1-AhR axis drove ciliated-to-mucous transdifferentiation; viral M2 protein suppressed TP73-FOXJ1-RFX3 axis and promoted FOXJ1 degradation
comments: Elegant integration of in vivo imaging, lineage tracing, and multi-omics reveals dual host-pathogen mechanisms underlying post-viral muco-obstructive disease, offering multiple therapeutic intervention points.

model_io.model: Male mice infected with H1N1 PR8 strain

hypotheses.hypothesis: IFN-IDO1-AhR immune-mediated axis drives ciliated-to-mucous transdifferentiation post-infection

hypotheses.hypothesis: Viral M2 protein directly suppresses ciliary development through TP73-FOXJ1-RFX3 axis inhibition and FOXJ1 proteasomal degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; M2 protein identified as key ciliary loss driver via suppression of regulatory axis and promotion of FOXJ1 degradation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Developmental senescence niches serve as transient regulatory checkpoints that become aberrantly sustained in BPD

Evolutionary rates, transmission dynamics, reassortment signatures

title: Multidimensional cognitive assessment of preservice middle school mathematics teachers’ proportional reasoning skills
task: Assessing proportional reasoning mastery in preservice middle school mathematics teachers
key_results: Only ~33% mastered all three proportional reasoning attributes; ~20% mastered none; major difficulties: comparing numerically complex ratios, using ratios for real-world attributes, distinguishing additive/multiplicative reasoning
comments: Uses Hierarchical Diagnostic Classification Model on 747 PSTs via 45-item diagnostic test; identifies specific skill gaps for targeted curriculum improvement.

hypotheses.hypothesis: PSTs demonstrate uneven mastery across three proportional reasoning attributes
hypotheses.result: Only 33% achieved full mastery; numerically complex ratios and real-world applications identified as primary weakness areas

title: A hybrid CNN-BiLSTM-attention model optimized by an improved sparrow search algorithm for identity authentication and anomaly detection in electricity markets
task: Identity authentication and anomaly detection in electricity markets via hybrid CNN-BiLSTM-attention with improved sparrow search
key_results: Accuracy 98.71%, F1 0.98.43% on simulated electricity data; averaged across three datasets: 98.31% accuracy; improved sparrow search (Tent chaos + adaptive inertia + Cauchy-Gaussian perturbation) outperforms baseline hyperparameter tuning
comments: Addresses cybersecurity threats (spoofing, replay, tampering) in digitalized electricity markets; bimodal feature engineering combines behavioral and network traffic signals; improved metaheuristic addresses hyperparameter sensitivity.

model_io.model: Hybrid CNN-BiLSTM-attention + improved sparrow search optimizer

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid deep learning with improved metaheuristic optimization achieves robust identity authentication
hypotheses.result: 98.71% accuracy on electricity market data; improved sparrow search outperforms conventional hyperparameter tuning

title: Quantification and classification of carbon nanotubes in electron micrographs using vision foundation models
task: Automated carbon nanotube quantification and classification in electron microscopy via vision foundation models
key_results: 89.5% cross-validated accuracy, 92.7% held-out test accuracy for 4-morphology CNT classification; Segment Anything Model achieves near-perfect segmentation; outperforms baseline with fraction of training data (~1800 TEM images)
comments: Leverages zero-shot segmentation (SAM) + self-supervised feature learning (DINOv2) for high-throughput nanomaterial analysis; instance-level processing resolves mixed samples; transforms labor-intensive bottleneck into scalable pipeline.

model_io.model: Segment Anything Model + DINOv2 vision transformer (spatially constrained feature extraction)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Zero-shot segmentation with self-supervised feature learning enables high-accuracy CNT morphology classification
hypotheses.result: 92.7% test accuracy with minimal training data; SAM enables near-perfect segmentation; instance-level processing resolves mixed samples

title: A Bayesian-evolutionary game framework for robust multi-agent workforce scheduling in resilient supply chains
task: Coordinating multi-agent workforce allocation under supply-chain disruptions
key_results: BEHG-RSO framework: 93.6% workforce utilization, 9.9% cost reduction vs. MARL, 25.5% faster recovery; validated via ablation and uncertainty analyses
comments: Integrates Bayesian game theory with robust stochastic optimization; practical industrial implementation with computational scalability validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bayesian partner-reliability estimates improve coordination over reinforcement learning
hypotheses.result: BEHG-RSO achieves 9.9% cost reduction and significantly faster recovery under disruptions

title: Stability analysis of networked control systems using three-layer delay modelling
task: Analyzing delay effects in networked control systems for industrial automation
key_results: Three-layer delay model decouples intra-device and protocol-stack delays; derives exact MACD via frequency-domain Phase Margin; layer-aware Smith Predictor compensates transport delays
comments: Addresses practical engineering challenge of multi-layer latency in industrial NCS; validates on benchmark loop configurations with stability margin improvements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Explicit delay decomposition improves stability analysis over lumped-delay models
hypotheses.result: Three-layer model enables precise MACD calculation and identifies uncompensated internal delays as performance bottleneck

title: Trigonometric cubic $$\mathscr {B}$$ -spline collocation approach for system of singularly perturbed turning point problem with integral boundary conditions
task: Solving singularly perturbed turning point problems via trigonometric cubic B-spline collocation
key_results: TCBSCM on Shishkin mesh achieves near-second-order convergence; numerically validated against FDM and cubic B-spline benchmarks
comments: Addresses challenge of boundary layer resolution at turning points; theoretical analysis and experimental validation provide confidence in method robustness.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trigonometric B-splines on adaptive Shishkin mesh better capture layer behavior than polynomial splines
hypotheses.result: TCBSCM demonstrates improved convergence behavior compared to CBSCM and FDM

title: Systematic evaluation of machine learning and explainable AI for NOx emission prediction in gas turbine systems
task: Predicting NOx emissions in gas turbines via ML with comprehensive explainability
key_results: Bayesian-optimized LightGBM achieves R² 0.8928, RMSE 3.7694; SHAP + 6 XAI methods identify ambient/inlet temperature and exhaust pressure as dominant factors
comments: Demonstrates concurrent achievement of high predictive accuracy and transparency; systematic evaluation of 10 regression models with unified XAI suite.

model_io.model: LightGBM (Bayesian-optimized) + XAI suite (SHAP, PFI, PDP, ICE, LIME, surrogate, residual)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble models with XAI achieve both accuracy and interpretability
hypotheses.result: LightGBM outperforms 9 competitors; XAI techniques converge on 4 dominant environmental/thermal factors

title: Forecasting weekly influenza-like illness counts in chongqing using a temporal attention-based multisource network (TAM-Net)
task: Forecasting weekly influenza-like illness via temporal attention-based multisource network
key_results: TAM-Net achieves 1–4-week forecasting: RMSE 1,418.06±104.93, R² 0.754±0.037; forecast-horizon-wise adaptive gating dynamically adjusts branch contributions; rolling-origin validation confirms predictive performance
comments: Addresses temporal pattern heterogeneity across surveillance, search, and meteorological data via branch-specific encoders and forecast-horizon-aware fusion; single-region retrospective evaluation limits generalizability.

model_io.model: TAM-Net (branch-specific LSTM/TCN + multi-head self-attention + forecast-horizon adaptive gating)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Forecast-horizon-wise adaptive fusion improves multi-source integration for multi-step ILI forecasting
hypotheses.result: TAM-Net achieves R² 0.754±0.037; adaptive gating mechanism dynamically adjusts historical vs. exogenous contributions across horizons

title: Multi-label bridge damage segmentation with topology supervision and conformal calibration
task: Multi-label bridge damage segmentation with topology supervision and uncertainty calibration
key_results: Macro-IoU 0.758, Macro-Dice 0.861, Boundary F1 0.792; ECE 0.016, Brier 0.094; conformal calibration coverage 0.793–0.849 under compound corruptions
comments: Combines ViT encoder with boundary + clDice loss and label-conditional conformal calibration; external transfer and field robustness remain unvalidated.

model_io.model: ViT-S/16 + rank-48 adapter + progressive decoding + conformal calibration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topology supervision and conformal calibration improve geometry preservation and uncertainty reliability
hypotheses.result: Boundary F1 0.792, ECE 0.016 demonstrate improved mask quality and calibration vs. baseline approaches

title: A prediction–optimization–decision framework for logistics network design under demand and disruption uncertainty
task: Logistics network design integrating demand prediction and disruption risk optimization
key_results: ST-GNN prediction MAE 8.2–15.6% lower than Transformer; risk F1 0.847 (6.2% above XGBoost); optimization cost 13.4% lower than stochastic programming; 16.9% 12-month cost reduction
comments: Three-layer architecture (prediction-risk-optimization) with RL-enhanced large-scale solver; demonstrates practical value of integrated ML-optimization framework.

model_io.model: ST-GNN + multi-head attention (prediction) + attention-based multi-label classification (risk) + RL-enhanced neighborhood search (optimization)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrated prediction-optimization-decision reduces costs and improves resilience vs. sequential approaches
hypotheses.result: Framework achieves 16.9% 12-month cost reduction with 5.6pp service level improvement

title: A predictive and reinforcement learning-driven framework for adaptive cybersecurity training and behavioral risk mitigation
task: Predicting phishing susceptibility and adapting cybersecurity training via reinforcement learning
key_results: Extra Trees classifier: 80% accuracy, 79% F1-score, 0.88 ROC-AUC; K-Means clustering reveals behavioral personas with significant phishing-risk variance; Q-learning enables adaptive training
comments: Integrates supervised learning (susceptibility prediction), unsupervised clustering (persona segmentation), and RL (adaptive intervention); among first unified human-centered cybersecurity architecture.

model_io.model: Extra Trees (phishing prediction) + K-Means (behavioral clustering) + Q-learning (adaptive training)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating susceptibility prediction, behavioral segmentation, and RL-based training improves cybersecurity outcomes
hypotheses.result: ET classifier achieves 80% accuracy; K-Means reveals behavioral personas with significant risk variance; Q-learning enables personalized intervention

title: Digital transformation and capital market stability: evidence from China
task: Assessing corporate digital transformation impact on capital market sentiment stability
key_results: Digital transformation negatively related to sentiment beta; effect more pronounced for firms with high information acquisition costs; reduces analyst forecast dispersion and earnings opacity
comments: Demonstrates market stabilization mechanism through information transparency; uses A-share 2008–2022 panel data with robustness validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Digital transformation reduces sentiment-driven stock volatility
hypotheses.result: Negative relationship with sentiment beta confirmed; mechanism: improved information transparency and reduced forecast dispersion

title: Talking AI, doing less? Economic policy uncertainty and AI strategy-implementation misalignment
task: Analyzing AI strategy-implementation misalignment under economic policy uncertainty
key_results: Higher EPU widens AI strategy-implementation gap; financing constraints and managerial short-termism are transmission channels; misalignment reduces future innovation, financial performance, and valuation
comments: Uses pretrained LM to construct proxy measure of disclosure-action consistency; demonstrates economic costs of strategic-operational decoupling.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Economic policy uncertainty increases gap between AI strategy articulation and implementation investment
hypotheses.result: Higher EPU associated with greater misalignment; financing constraints and short-termism identified as mechanisms; misalignment reduces innovation output and firm value

title: Discoverability Policy Design for Platform: Consider Customer Rating and Seller Competition
task: Designing optimal platform discoverability policies under rating and competition constraints
key_results: Game-theoretic characterization of platform optimal policy accounting for adverse selection; identifies conditions for ultra-low pricing and rating gaming
comments: Theoretical framework providing nuanced lens on rating-discoverability interplay; reveals market inefficiencies from platform design choices.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discoverability services and consumer ratings interact strategically, potentially creating adverse selection
hypotheses.result: Three-party game analysis shows platforms may inadvertently incentivize low-quality sellers to game system via pricing

title: Visible light drives bright extreme-ultraviolet high harmonics
task: Generate high-flux coherent XUV light via high-harmonic generation with visible-wavelength driver
key_results: Conversion efficiency up to 10⁻⁶ in single harmonic line; 1.8 × 10¹¹ photons/s at 13.5 nm (91.8 eV) with <10 W average power, exceeding prior reports by >10×
comments: Plasma-core self-guiding enables practical power-scalable XUV generation, addressing a key limitation of harmonic conversion efficiency.

inputs: visible laser (516 nm, frequency-doubled ytterbium, <10 W average power)
outputs: XUV photon flux (1.8 × 10¹¹ photons/s at 13.5 nm)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Plasma-core-induced self-guiding sustains high intensity and favorable phase matching over extended propagation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally; enables bright high-order harmonics with low-power driver

title: Entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity enables near-decoupled polarization–strain behavior for high-density energy storage
task: Engineer polar heterogeneity via entropy to decouple polarization-strain and improve dielectric energy storage
key_results: Ultralow electrostrictive coefficient Q₃₃ ~0.010 m⁴/C² in high-entropy relaxor; recoverable energy storage density 21.5 J/cm³ at 1200 kV/cm with electrostrain 0.073% at 300 kV/cm
comments: Entropy engineering offers a systematic materials design strategy for lead-free dielectrics with competing material requirements, though scalability to practical device levels remains to be demonstrated.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Configurational entropy reduces polarization-strain coupling via chemical heterogeneity and strain-field fluctuations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; entropy-mediated polar fragmentation suppresses electrostrictive response while preserving polarization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Entropy-engineered heterogeneous polarization states redistribute elastic energy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by phase-field simulations; elastic energy decoupling enables decoupled polarization-strain behavior

title: Theoretical design and structure–property relationship of symmetric and asymmetric benzoheterocycle-based triphenylamine hole-transport materials for n–i–p perovskite solar cells
task: Design hole-transport materials for perovskite solar cells via computational screening
key_results: Se-Sym derivative shows smallest HOMO-LUMO gap (2.27 eV) and longest absorption wavelength (460.73 nm); O-Asym exhibits lowest hole reorganization energy (0.136 eV)
comments: DFT-based design is thorough but requires experimental validation and device testing to assess practical performance.

inputs: 14 triphenylamine-based molecules with benzoheterocyclic cores (O, S, N, Se atoms)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Heterocyclic core and molecular symmetry jointly influence optoelectronic properties
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; symmetric and asymmetric structures show distinct property distributions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Se-Sym is a promising HTM candidate for n-i-p perovskite devices
hypotheses.result: Identified as candidate based on favorable bandgap and absorption, pending experimental validation

title: Coherent state sampling for molecular vibronic spectra
task: Scalable sampling scheme for molecular vibronic spectra via coherent-state sampling on photonic hardware
key_results: Laptop and superconducting-detector implementations reproduce pentacene reference spectra with high fidelity; band shapes agree well with experiment; fixed hardware complexity scales via iteration count
comments: CSS provides practical scalability compared to vibronic boson sampling but trades quantum advantage for deterministic reproducibility and linear-coupling-model restrictions.

model_io.model: Coherent-state sampling (CSS) for Linear Coupling Model vibronic spectroscopy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single reconfigurable optical channel with fixed hardware achieves scalability via measurement iteration rather than modal expansion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CSS workflow scales to larger systems without proportional hardware growth

hypotheses.hypothesis: CSS provides high-fidelity state-resolved spectra for linear-coupling-model systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for pentacene; spectra match reference calculations and experimental band shapes

title: Deep neural network-controlled autonomous laser oscillation
task: Autonomous laser-cavity alignment using deep neural networks and spatial light modulators
key_results: Single trained DNN model recovers laser oscillation from non-lasing states within 2 feedback updates after manual reinstallation; demonstrates generalization without retraining
comments: Transfer learning capability is impressive, but demonstration is limited to one optical configuration and would benefit from testing across diverse cavity architectures.

model_io.model: Deep neural network with liquid-crystal-on-silicon spatial light modulator feedback

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pre-lasing spatial emission patterns contain actionable information about latent cavity state
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DNN learns to predict alignment from ASE images and recovers lasing after perturbation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Trained model generalizes to coarsely reinstalled configurations without retraining
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in 3 independent tests; demonstrates robustness to manual misalignment
